Orange Business is here!
About us
Join us at Orange Business!  

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.  

Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.


About the role**Mission**


The TA (RCC) Manager focuses on transforming recruitment practices to meet strategic organizational goals, ensuring a diverse pipeline of talent that aligns with our business objectives across the region.

**Main activities**

* Manage and run the regional recruitment competency center.
* Lead the regional RCC team to provide end\-to\-end resourcing expertise and support to hiring managers and enhance candidate experience.
* Act as resourcing partner for the business: Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment of the recruitment process with business needs.
* Understand internal client requirements and business challenges to find the right candidates.
* Drive the performance of the regional RCC team to have a strong delivery and execution in fulfilling hiring needs and improve time to hire and quality of profiles, while ensuring delivery against agreed KPIs and continuously improving outcomes.
* Act as the recruitment POC for a portfolio of internal clients hiring high\-end or niche skill sets.
* Design and develop innovative talent acquisition strategies that meet business needs and priorities.
* Implement innovative sourcing strategies to enhance brand visibility and create a pipeline of high\-caliber talent for the organization in timely and cost\-effective manner.
* Monitor sourcing strategy and recruitment costs; measure and track KPIs and SLAs.
* Develop and manage relationships with external search partners.
* Be the single point of contact for global processes and projects alongside the Regional Manager.
* Act in hybrid role, being strategic and tactical; hands on recruitment delivery of assigned roles (3 to 5 active, hands\-on requisitions simultaneously), with key focus on sourcing for leadership and critical/ difficult niche roles.
* Work in close alignment with International Resourcing Operations Manager to ensure adoption and implementation of global standards, tools and performance frameworks.
* Maintain synergy with other TA (RCC) Managers, country HR, SSC managers and global stakeholders.


About you**Qualifications**

**Education:** Should possess a master’s degree in human resources or a related field.**Experience:** 8\+ years of experience in talent acquisition delivery with at least 3 years in a telecom and IT services organization is essential. Experience leading team of TA Specialists. Experience in international sourcing with exposure to multiple region geographies enhances the ideal candidate profile.**Key Skills, Knowledge \& Abilities****Professional skills:*** This role requires a balance of strategic and tactical talent acquisition skills, with hands\-on experience in sourcing critical and niche roles.
* Proficiency in end\-to\-end recruitment processes in Telecom \& IT Services environments is required.
* Solid knowledge of social networks and digital platforms is necessary for modern recruiting strategies.

**Soft skills:*** A proven track record in developing strong relationships with functional leaders and other stakeholders is essential.
* Demonstrated leadership skills, including effective coaching, motivating, and empowering staff to build successful teams.
* An ability to drive results through well\-defined goals and accountability in individual and team performance is crucial.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, complemented by strong change management capabilities, are necessary.
* Adaptability to work in a multicultural environment while maintaining a strong customer service orientation is critical.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Advanced in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken

  

You bring passion, energy, taste for exploration and adaptability. You seek the opportunity to expand your knowledge and develop new skills.


What we offer* **Global Opportunities:** Work in multi\-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* **Flexible Work Environment:** Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* **Professional Development:** training programs and upskilling/re\-skilling opportunities.
* **Career Growth:** Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* **Caring and Daring Culture:** Health and well\-being programs and benefits, diversity \& inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* **Reward Programs:** Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
### **Description**

  

Based in Gurugram, you will lead our newly established software team (currently four engineers) as we enter an exciting new phase of expansion. We are seeking an Engineering Manager who will build a strong, happy, high\-performing team, creating the environment, clarity, and support that enables people to do their best work. This is a people\-first role: you will have proven strength in leadership, scaling teams, and developing others. You will report to the Head of Software Product Engineering.  

Aurora’s mission is to help drive the energy transition through data\-driven energy market intelligence and software that supports decision\-makers across the power system. You will partner closely with colleagues in Oxford and across the business to help the team build customer\-facing software that delivers on this mission.
  

Our platform includes microservices and modern web applications (TypeScript/Node, React, AWS). While this is a leadership\-focused role, you will still do some hands\-on senior engineering work, contributing code when needed, leading by example on quality, and helping the team make sound technical decisions
  

You will establish the people and process foundations for an effective engineering team: regular 1:1s, coaching and feedback, inclusive ways of working, and strong delivery practices (planning, stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives). A key part of the role is growing the team through hiring, attracting, assessing, and onboarding great talent in Gurugram.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead and grow the Gurugram engineering team, creating a positive, inclusive, high\-trust culture with strong team health and engagement.
* Hire, onboard, and retain great engineers, owning the hiring process end\-to\-end in partnership with HR and engineering leadership.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members through 1:1s, goal setting, feedback, and growth plans; support performance management when needed.
* Contribute as a senior engineer: write and review code, guide architecture and technical design, and continuously raise the bar on engineering standards (testing, reliability, and maintainability).
* Run effective engineering processes and ceremonies (planning, daily coordination, reviews, and especially high\-quality retrospectives) that drive continuous improvement and predictable delivery.
* Partner with Product and stakeholders to shape priorities, manage expectations, and ensure the team delivers valuable outcomes with a sustainable pace and high quality

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 **Required attributes:*** Strong people leadership and emotional intelligence: able to build trust, communicate clearly, handle difficult conversations, and foster psychological safety.
* Proven experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineers (including regular 1:1s, feedback, goal setting, and progression support), with a genuine interest in people development.
* Demonstrated hiring capability: defining roles, running structured interviews, assessing both technical and behavioural skills, and making high\-quality hiring decisions.
* Experience running effective team processes (e.g., planning, reviews, and retrospectives) and using outcomes to drive continuous improvement.
* Able to lead within a distributed environment and collaborate effectively with Oxford\-based colleagues through proactive communication and inclusion.
* Experience working hands\-on with our (or similar) stack: Node/TypeScript, ExpressJS, React, SQL/NoSQL, AWS and microservices.
* Strong organisational skills: can balance competing priorities, create clarity, and follow through on commitments.

**Desirable attributes:*** Experience using delivery metrics (e.g., DORA) to inform team practices.
* Experience with engineering quality practices such as unit testing and CI/CD pipelines.

  

### **What we offer**

  

Some of the benefits we include are:* Accidental, term life and medical insurance
* Hybrid Work model
* Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
* Maternity leave
* A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.

To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.  

  

Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.### **About Aurora Energy Research**


From its academic roots, Aurora Energy Research is a thriving, rapidly growing company, currently serving over 1000 of the world’s most influential energy sector participants, including utilities, investors, and governments.  

  

While we constantly strive to reach new markets and diversify our product portfolio, we are already active across the globe in Asia\-Pacific, Latin America, Europe, South Africa and North America, working with leading organisations to provide comprehensive market intelligence, bespoke analytic and advisory services, and cutting\-edge software.  

  

We are a diverse team of experts with vast energy, financial, and consulting backgrounds, covering power, hydrogen, carbon, and fossil commodities. With this, we provide data\-driven intelligence to fuel strategic decisions in the global energy transformation.

title: SAP Project & Operations Lead
description:
**Purpose of Position:**

The SAP Project \& Operations Lead serves as the primary functional focal point across Project System (PS), Plant Maintenance (PM), Production Planning (PP), and Quality Management (QM) within the Group\-wide SAP S/4HANA environment

The role ensures stable operational processes, supports continuous improvement, leads solution design, and enables best\-practice process adoption across all operating companies.

This position serves as the primary functional authority for operations\-related modules and works closely with business stakeholders, SAP partners, and internal CoE teams to ensure efficient and reliable SAP\-enabled business processes.

The role also provides leadership, mentoring and functional direction to Associate Consultants and contributes to the long\-term enhancement and standardization of SAP operations processes across the Group.

**Key Responsibilities \& Accountabilities:**

**SAP Functional Ownership**

1\. Lead functional ownership of PM, PS, PP, and QM modules across the SAP S/4HANA Group instance.

2\. Manage solution architecture and ensure alignment to SAP best practices and business process standards.

3\. Lead Fit\-to\-Standard, solution design, configuration review, and functional specification development.

**Operational Excellence \& Support**

4\. Ensure stable system operations, manage L2/L3 incidents, perform root\-cause analysis, and resolve cross\-functional issues.

5\. Oversee the associate’s daily support work, ensuring timely resolution of operational tickets and adherence to CoE processes.

6\. Monitor integration touchpoints with MM, FICO, HR, Procurement, EHS, and SCM to maintain data and process consistency.

**Enhancements, Change Management, and Optimization**

7\. Identify and lead enhancement initiatives across PM, PS, PP, and QM to improve performance, usability, and compliance.

8\. Develop functional specifications, coordinate with technical teams (ABAP, BTP, Integration), and validate delivered solutions.

9\. Lead the testing lifecycle (SIT/UAT), including developing test scripts, validating results, and ensuring quality assurance.

**Business Engagement \& Governance**

10\. Collaborate with business owners (Operations, Engineering, Projects, Manufacturing, HSE, QA) to analyse pain points and improvement opportunities.

11\. Define and maintain process documentation, SOPs, functional specifications, solution documentation, and training materials.

12\. Ensure compliance with audit requirements, internal controls, change management processes, and system governance.

**Reporting \& Analytics Alignment**

13\. Work closely with the SAP Analytics \& Reporting Consultant to support operational dashboards, KPIs, and reporting for operations functions.

14\. Validate data accuracy for operational KPIs across PP, PM, PS, and QM.

**Leadership \& CoE Development**

15\. Guide and mentor the Associate Consultants assigned to operations modules.

16\. Contribute to SAP roadmap discussions and future CoE capability development.

17\. Represent the operations domain in Group SAP governance forums (SteerCo, Change Advisory Board, etc.)

**Principal Challenges:**

1\. Managing complex integration across PM, PS, PP, and QM within a single SAP instance used by multiple companies across the group.

2\. Balancing heavy operational support with enhancement demands and strategic improvement initiatives.

3\. Standardizing processes across operating companies with varying maturity levels.

4\. Ensuring strong change control and avoiding disruption to mission\-critical operations.

5\. Managing cross\-functional dependencies and ensuring alignment between technical and functional teams.

**Minimum Academic \& Professional Qualifications**:

1\. Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or an equivalent field.

2\. SAP S/4HANA certification in PM, PP, or PS is required (multiple certifications are advantageous).

3\. Proven experience with SAP Activate methodology, including fit\-to\-standard analysis, testing cycles, and deployment phases, is required

4\. Strong understanding of manufacturing, maintenance, project management, and quality process cycles.

5\. Additional certifications or learning in process architecture, or solution governance is an advantage

**Minimum Work Experience:** 

1\. 7 to 10 years of hands\-on experience delivering and supporting SAP PM, PS, PP, and QM modules.

2\. Proven experience leading solution design, configuration oversight, testing, and deployment in at least two full\-cycle SAP implementations or major rollout projects (S/4HANA preferred).

3\. Strong track record in stabilizing operations, resolving cross\-module issues, and improving system performance.

4\. Experience working directly with senior business stakeholders and managing functional expectations.

5\. Prior experience guiding junior consultants or support analysts is strongly preferred.

6\. Exposure to SAP BTP integrations, Fiori apps, digital maintenance, and manufacturing execution systems is a plus.

**Skills \& Competencies Required:**

· **Technical \& Functional Skills**

1\. Deep functional expertise in PM, PS, PP, and QM with proven configuration and solution design knowledge.

2\. Strong understanding of cross\-functional processes (MM, FICO, HR, Procurement, and SCM).

3\. Proficiency in defining functional specifications, validating technical development, and coordinating with technical teams.

4\. Strong understanding of S/4HANA master data (materials, equipment, BOM, routing, WBS, work centers).

5\. Experience in troubleshooting performance, integration, and data integrity issues.

6\. Familiarity with process automation, workflow, and enhancement frameworks.

7\. Knowledge of SAP role/authorization framework for operational areas.

· **Soft Skills**

1\. Strong leadership qualities with the ability to mentor and guide an associate.

2\. Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage senior stakeholders.

3\. Highly analytical and structured problem\-solving ability.

4\. Strong documentation, process mapping, and presentation skills.

5\. Ability to manage multiple workstreams and prioritize under pressure.

6\. High level of accountability and ownership of module performance.

7\. Continuous improvement mindset and willingness to adopt new SAP innovations.

8\. Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset with the ability to break down complex SAP issues.

**QHSSE Responsibilities:**

1\. Comply with all organizational Quality, Health, Safety, Security, and Environment (QHSSE) policies and procedures.

2\. Ensure that all SAP support activities follow documented quality standards and audit requirements.

3\. Proactively identify and report any risks or non\-compliances that may impact system integrity or business operations.

4\. Maintain secure handling of system access, data privacy, and sensitive business information.

5\. Promote a safe and compliant working environment through accountability, awareness, and continuous improvement.

title: HR Intern
description:
Below is a professional **HR Intern Job Description (JD)** tailored for a **Cloud Kitchen \& QSR** environment.

JOB DESCRIPTION – HR INTERN

**Company:** BETR INDIA FOODWORKS PVT. LTD.  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Position:** HR Intern  
**Industry:** Cloud Kitchen \& QSR  
**Location:** Delhi NCR / Gurgaon  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time Internship  
**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 Year  
**Stipend:** As per company policy

About the Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic and responsible **HR Intern** to support the HR team in managing day\-to\-day HR operations across our **Cloud Kitchen and QSR outlets**.

The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, basic knowledge of MS Office/Excel, and an interest in recruitment and employee management.

Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Hiring

* Assist in sourcing candidates for kitchen, F\&B service, operations, and support roles.
* Coordinate with candidates for interview scheduling and follow\-ups.
* Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
* Assist HR in conducting interview coordination and joining formalities.
* Support hiring drives and walk\-in interviews.

2\. Employee Onboarding

* Collect and verify employee joining documents.
* Prepare and maintain employee personal files.
* Assist with offer letters, LOIs, joining forms, and other HR documentation.
* Coordinate employee induction and orientation.

3\. Attendance \& Payroll Support

* Maintain daily attendance records for employees across outlets.
* Assist in tracking late coming, absenteeism, weekly offs, leave, and LOP.
* Support monthly payroll data preparation.
* Maintain accurate employee attendance and salary\-related records.

4\. HR Operations

* Maintain employee master data and HR trackers.
* Assist with uniform, ID card, SIM, laptop, and other company asset records.
* Maintain employee documents and HR files.
* Support preparation of HR letters, notices, and internal communications.
* Coordinate with outlet managers regarding employee\-related matters.

5\. Employee Engagement \& Discipline

* Assist HR in employee engagement activities.
* Support implementation of company HR policies.
* Help communicate attendance, grooming, leave, and workplace policies.
* Escalate employee concerns to the HR team/HR Manager.

6\. Exit \& Full \& Final Support

* Assist in resignation and exit formalities.
* Collect company assets from exiting employees.
* Coordinate exit documentation and clearance.
* Assist in maintaining F\&F and separation records.

Skills Required

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Excel and MS Word**.
* Good organizational and documentation skills.
* Ability to coordinate with employees and outlet managers.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced **QSR / Cloud Kitchen** environment.
* Basic understanding of HR processes will be an advantage.

Educational Qualification

* Pursuing or completed **BBA / MBA / PGDM / B.Com / any graduation** with an interest in Human Resources.
* Freshers are welcome to apply.

Key Performance Areas (KPIs)

* Timely recruitment coordination.
* Accurate employee documentation.
* Attendance and HR data accuracy.
* Timely completion of joining and exit formalities.
* Employee communication and follow\-up.
* Proper maintenance of HR records.

Work Environment

The role will involve coordination with **HR, Operations, Kitchen Teams, Outlet Managers, and employees** across Cloud Kitchen and QSR operations.

**Career Opportunity:**  
Successful candidates may be considered for a full\-time HR Executive / HR Associate role based on performance and business requirements.

Pay: ₹8,086\.00 \- ₹13,919\.30 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

Work Location: In person

HR Specialist
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.

* Prepare, validate, and facilitate the issuance of HR letters and employment\-related documentation, including offer letters, promotion letters, transfer letters, experience letters, and other employee correspondence, ensuring accuracy and compliance.

Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Learning strategy and capability building

Talent and leadership development

* Design and manage global talent and leadership development programs, including offers for emerging leaders, high potentials and critical talent groups.
* Build career development pathways and learning journeys that support career growth and internal mobility.
* Partner with stakeholders on succession\-related development and targeted capability building.
* Support onboarding, upskilling and reskilling as part of an integrated talent approach.


Organizational development

* Contribute to organizational development work such as capability modeling, role architecture and organizational effectiveness.
* Support the design of career frameworks and organizational capability assessments.
* Bring a learning lens to change and transformation initiatives.


Learning technology and measurement

* Work with our HRIS and technology teams to make the most of our learning management system and other learning technologies.
* Manage learning content deployment, learner experience, reporting and analytics.
* Measure learning effectiveness through data, feedback and business impact, and act on what you find.
* Track external trends and emerging technologies to keep our learning ecosystem current.

**About you**


Must\-have

* At least five years of experience in learning and development, talent development, instructional design or a related field.
* Experience designing and delivering global learning and talent programs in a multinational organization.
* A track record of building learning solutions across classroom, virtual, hybrid and digital channels.
* Experience designing leadership development or talent acceleration programs.
* Experience building learning journeys, development pathways or career frameworks.
* Experience working with a learning management system.
* Strong knowledge of instructional design methods, for example ADDIE, SAM, design thinking or learning experience design, and a solid grounding in adult learning theory.

* Excellent communication and storytelling, strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, and a global, intercultural mindset.

Nice\-to\-have

* Certification in instructional design, learning experience design, adult learning, facilitation, coaching or leadership development.

* Experience with AI\-enabled learning solutions and adaptive learning platforms.
* Experience developing large\-scale global leadership academies or enterprise reskilling initiatives.
* Knowledge of organizational design, workforce planning or change management methodologies.
* Familiarity with skills\-based talent management and career architecture frameworks.
* Additional language skills beyond English.

**How you work**


We are looking for someone whose way of working reflects our values:

* Caring. You build trusted relationships, listen well and keep learners and colleagues at the center of what you design.
* Entrepreneurial. You take ownership, show initiative and stay focused on the impact your work has on the business.
* Forward\-Thinking. You bring curiosity and a digital mindset, and you keep improving how we learn and develop.
* Reliable. You deliver quality work on time, follow through on commitments and measure whether it worked.


Inclusion and social diversity are firmly anchored values in our corporate culture. Regardless of gender, age, any disabilities, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity: We are looking forward to meeting you!

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right.
